# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Reuse the original Python SF100 scanner/receiver, then retain a complete
# portable Ruby customer edition. This operation only reads the finalized room.
require_relative "native_dataset"
require "time"

module Starforge
  class NativeDatasetReceiving
    RESULT_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-received.v1"
    PYTHON_ROOT = "stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/python"
    NATIVE_ROOT = "stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli"
    ENTRY = PYTHON_ROOT + "/native-dataset-receive.py"
    attr_reader :directory

    def self.selected_request(directory)
      root = Files.directory(directory)
      bytes = Files.read(File.join(root,"request.json"),1_048_576)
      request = Files.parse(bytes)
      Files.need(request.is_a?(Hash) && request["schema"] == NativeDatasetDelivery::SELECTION_SCHEMA &&
        request["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" &&
        [nil,"selected-absolute"].include?(request["runtimePathMode"]) &&
        %w[datasetId sourceKey].all? { |key| INTENT.match?(request[key].to_s) } &&
        HASH.match?(request["nativeManifestSha256"].to_s), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_REQUEST_INVALID")
      [root,request,bytes]
    end

    # A completed business operation opens from its own received bytes. Neither
    # the original room nor the original runtime has to remain mounted.
    def self.received(directory:, expected_manifest_sha256: nil)
      root,request,bytes = selected_request(directory)
      receipt = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(root,"received.json"),1_048_576))
      Files.need(receipt.is_a?(Hash) && receipt["schema"] == RESULT_SCHEMA &&
        receipt["requestSha256"] == Files.hash(bytes) && receipt["datasetId"] == request["datasetId"] &&
        receipt["sourceKey"] == request["sourceKey"] && receipt["sourceId"] == request["nativeManifestSha256"] &&
        receipt["directory"] == File.join(root,"received") &&
        HASH.match?(receipt["manifestSha256"].to_s) &&
        (expected_manifest_sha256.nil? || expected_manifest_sha256 == receipt["manifestSha256"]),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_BUSINESS_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
      delivery = DatasetDelivery.open(receipt["directory"],expected_manifest_sha256: receipt["manifestSha256"])
      Files.need(delivery.is_a?(NativeDatasetDelivery) &&
        delivery.file_bytes("selection.json",limit: 1_048_576) == bytes &&
        delivery.manifest["datasetId"] == request["datasetId"] &&
        delivery.manifest["sourceKey"] == request["sourceKey"] &&
        delivery.source_sha256 == request["nativeManifestSha256"] &&
        delivery.descriptor("native-receiving.json")["sha256"] == receipt["nativeReceiptSha256"],
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_BUSINESS_DELIVERY_CHANGED")
      delivery
    end

    def self.resume(directory:, cancel: nil, timeout: 1800)
      root,request,_bytes = selected_request(directory)
      return received(directory: root) if File.exist?(File.join(root,"received.json"))
      receiver = allocate
      receiver.send(:initialize_retained,root,request,_bytes)
      receiver.receive(cancel: cancel,timeout: timeout)
    end

    def self.status(directory:)
      root,request,bytes = selected_request(directory)
      if File.exist?(File.join(root,"received.json"))
        delivery = received(directory: root)
        return {"schema"=>RESULT_SCHEMA,"state"=>"RECEIVED","directory"=>root,
          "requestSha256"=>Files.hash(bytes),"datasetId"=>request["datasetId"],"sourceKey"=>request["sourceKey"],
          "delivery"=>delivery.directory,"manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,
          "sourceId"=>delivery.source_sha256,"rowCount"=>delivery.row_count,"fields"=>delivery.fields,
          "membership"=>delivery.membership,"files"=>delivery.manifest["files"]}
      end
      {"schema"=>RESULT_SCHEMA,"state"=>File.exist?(File.join(root,"native-receiving.json")) ?
        "NATIVE_RECEIVED" : "PREPARED","directory"=>root,"requestSha256"=>Files.hash(bytes),
        "datasetId"=>request["datasetId"],"sourceKey"=>request["sourceKey"],
        "sourceId"=>request["nativeManifestSha256"]}
    end

    def self.executable(path)
      Files.need(path.is_a?(String) && File.absolute_path(path) == path &&
        !path.include?("\0"), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXECUTABLE_REQUIRED")
      real = File.realpath(path)
      Files.need(File.file?(real) && File.executable?(real), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXECUTABLE_REQUIRED")
      # Keep the invoked path: Python locates pyvenv.cfg before resolving this
      # symlink (PEP 405). Launching the target would lose the selected environment.
      path
    end

    def self.matches_executable?(provided, retained, legacy: false)
      return false unless provided.is_a?(String) && retained.is_a?(String) &&
        !provided.include?("\0")
      absolute = File.expand_path(provided)
      return true if absolute == retained
      legacy && File.realpath(absolute) == retained
    rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES, Errno::ENOTDIR, Errno::ELOOP
      false
    end

    # Retain the selected original source modules, not a regenerated receiver.
    # The checks bracket the read-only call. Completed packets need no runtime.
    def self.runtime_binding(checkout, python, node)
      checkout = Files.directory(checkout,private: false)
      paths = [ENTRY,"stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf100-buyer-dataset-delivery/deliver.mjs"]
      [[NATIVE_ROOT,".mjs"],[PYTHON_ROOT,".mjs"],[PYTHON_ROOT+"/stellar_forge_buyer",".py"]].each do |relative,suffix|
        root = Files.directory(File.join(checkout,relative),private: false)
        Dir.children(root).sort.each do |name|
          paths << relative+"/"+name if name.end_with?(suffix) && /\A[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\z/.match?(name)
        end
      end
      files = paths.uniq.sort.map do |name|
        raw = Files.read(File.join(checkout,name))
        {"name"=>name,"bytes"=>raw.bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(raw)}
      end
      {"directory"=>checkout,"python"=>executable(python),"node"=>executable(node),"files"=>files}
    end

    def initialize(directory:, room:, source_key:, dataset_id:, expected_native_manifest_sha256:,
      checkout:, python:, node:)
      Files.need(INTENT.match?(source_key.to_s) && INTENT.match?(dataset_id.to_s) &&
        HASH.match?(expected_native_manifest_sha256.to_s), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
      selected_directory = File.expand_path(directory)
      if File.exist?(File.join(selected_directory,"request.json"))
        root,original,raw = self.class.selected_request(selected_directory)
        Files.lock(root) do
          runtime = original["runtime"]
          legacy = original["runtimePathMode"].nil?
          Files.need(original["room"] == File.expand_path(room) &&
            original["sourceKey"] == source_key && original["datasetId"] == dataset_id &&
            original["nativeManifestSha256"] == expected_native_manifest_sha256 &&
            runtime.is_a?(Hash) && runtime["directory"] == File.expand_path(checkout) &&
            self.class.matches_executable?(python,runtime["python"],legacy: legacy) &&
            self.class.matches_executable?(node,runtime["node"],legacy: legacy) &&
            Files.read(File.join(root,"request.json"),1_048_576) == raw,
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ORIGINAL_REQUEST_CHANGED")
          initialize_retained(root,original,raw)
        end
        return
      end
      @room = Files.directory(room)
      Files.directory(File.join(@room,"pages"))
      original = Files.read(File.join(@room,"manifest.json"),4_194_304)
      Files.need(Files.hash(original) == expected_native_manifest_sha256, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SOURCE_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
      @runtime = self.class.runtime_binding(checkout,python,node)
      @request = {"schema"=>NativeDatasetDelivery::SELECTION_SCHEMA,"sourceFormat"=>"SF100_SCAN",
        "sourceKey"=>source_key,"datasetId"=>dataset_id,"room"=>@room,
        "nativeManifestSha256"=>expected_native_manifest_sha256,"runtime"=>@runtime,
        "runtimePathMode"=>"selected-absolute"}
      @request_bytes = Files.json(@request).freeze
      Files.need(@request_bytes.bytesize <= 1_048_576, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RUNTIME_SELECTION_LIMIT")
      @request_sha256 = Files.hash(@request_bytes).freeze
      @directory = Files.directory(directory,create: true)
      Files.need(@directory != @room && !@directory.start_with?(@room+File::SEPARATOR) &&
        !@room.start_with?(@directory+File::SEPARATOR), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SEPARATE_RECEIVING_DIRECTORY_REQUIRED")
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"request.json"),@request_bytes)
        Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"attempts"),create: true)
        Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"received"),create: true)
      end
      DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@request)
      DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@runtime)
    end

    def same_request!
      Files.need(Files.read(File.join(@directory,"request.json"),1_048_576) == @request_bytes,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_REQUEST_CHANGED")
    end

    def receive(cancel: nil, timeout: 1800)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_request!
        return self.class.received(directory: @directory) if File.exist?(File.join(@directory,"received.json"))
        receipt_path = File.join(@directory,"native-receiving.json")
        unless File.exist?(receipt_path)
          Files.need(self.class.runtime_binding(@runtime["directory"],@runtime["python"],@runtime["node"]) == @runtime,
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RUNTIME_CHANGED")
          Files.need(Files.hash(Files.read(File.join(@room,"manifest.json"),4_194_304)) ==
            @request["nativeManifestSha256"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SOURCE_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
          attempt = Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"attempts",SecureRandom.uuid),create: true)
          Files.once(File.join(attempt,"attempt.json"),Files.json({"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-read.v1",
            "requestSha256"=>@request_sha256,"startedAt"=>Time.now.utc.iso8601(6)}))
          environment = {"LANG"=>"C.UTF-8","LC_ALL"=>"C.UTF-8","TZ"=>"UTC"}
          run = Runner.new(node: @runtime["python"],environment: environment).run(
            File.join(@runtime["directory"],ENTRY),
            ["--room",@room,"--node",@runtime["node"]],interpreter_arguments: ["-I","-B"],
            process_group: true,timeout: timeout,limit: 16_777_216,cancel: cancel)
          Files.once(File.join(attempt,"stdout.json"),run[:stdout])
          Files.once(File.join(attempt,"stderr.json"),run[:stderr])
          Files.once(File.join(attempt,"result.json"),Files.json({
            "schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-read-result.v1","requestSha256"=>@request_sha256,
            "exitStatus"=>run[:status].exitstatus,"termSignal"=>run[:status].termsig,"error"=>run[:error],
            "stdout"=>{"bytes"=>run[:stdout].bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(run[:stdout])},
            "stderr"=>{"bytes"=>run[:stderr].bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(run[:stderr])},
            "finishedAt"=>Time.now.utc.iso8601(6)}))
          raise Error, run[:error] if run[:error]
          unless run[:status].success?
            native_error = begin
              parsed = Files.parse(run[:stderr])
              parsed.is_a?(Hash) && /\A[A-Z0-9_]{1,120}\z/.match?(parsed["error"].to_s) ? parsed["error"] : nil
            rescue Error
              nil
            end
            raise Error, native_error || "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RECEIVING_FAILED"
          end
          Files.need(self.class.runtime_binding(@runtime["directory"],@runtime["python"],@runtime["node"]) == @runtime,
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RUNTIME_CHANGED")
          NativeDatasetDelivery.check_receipt(Files.parse(run[:stdout],decimals: true),
            room: @room,manifest_sha256: @request["nativeManifestSha256"])
          same_request!
          Files.once(receipt_path,run[:stdout])
        end
        raw = Files.read(receipt_path,16_777_216)
        receipt = Files.parse(raw,decimals: true)
        output_names,archive_names = NativeDatasetDelivery.check_receipt(receipt,
          room: @room,manifest_sha256: @request["nativeManifestSha256"])
        native = receipt.fetch("native")
        target = Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"received"))
        files = []
        (output_names+archive_names).each do |name|
          raise Error, "RUBY_NATIVE_CANCELLED" if cancel&.cancelled?
          original = native["outputs"][name] || native["archives"][name]
          descriptor = {"name"=>name,"bytes"=>original["bytes"],"sha256"=>original["sha256"]}
          copy_original(target,name,descriptor)
          files << descriptor
        end
        dictionary = files.find { |item| item["name"] == "semantics.json" }
        semantics = if dictionary
          DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(File.join(target,"semantics.json"),dictionary) do |stream|
            Files.parse(stream.read,decimals: true)
          end
        end
        source = {"schema"=>NativeDatasetDelivery::SOURCE_SCHEMA,"sourceFormat"=>"SF100_SCAN",
          "sourceKey"=>@request["sourceKey"],"datasetId"=>@request["datasetId"],"originalRoom"=>@room,
          "sourceId"=>receipt["sourceId"],"manifestSha256"=>receipt["manifestSha256"],
          "sourceBindingSha256"=>receipt["sourceBindingSha256"],
          "datasetName"=>native["originalNativeScan"]["name"],"columns"=>receipt["columns"],
          "providerIdentity"=>NativeDatasetDelivery.provider_identity(semantics),"semanticsFile"=>dictionary}
        metadata = {"selection.json"=>@request_bytes,"native-receiving.json"=>raw,"source.json"=>Files.json(source)}
        metadata.each do |name,bytes|
          NativeDatasetDelivery.check_descriptor(name,{"bytes"=>bytes.bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(bytes)})
          Files.once(File.join(target,name),bytes)
          files << {"name"=>name,"bytes"=>bytes.bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(bytes)}
        end
        scan = native.fetch("originalNativeScan")
        manifest = {"schema"=>NativeDatasetDelivery::SCHEMA,"sourceFormat"=>"SF100_SCAN",
          "sourceKey"=>@request["sourceKey"],"datasetId"=>@request["datasetId"],
          "sourceSha256"=>receipt["sourceId"],"nativeManifestSha256"=>receipt["manifestSha256"],
          "sourceBindingSha256"=>receipt["sourceBindingSha256"],"nativeReceiptSha256"=>Files.hash(raw),
          "sourceRecordSha256"=>Files.hash(metadata["source.json"]),"selectionSha256"=>@request_sha256,
          "snapshot"=>scan["snapshot"],"rowCount"=>scan["count"],"fields"=>scan["fields"],"files"=>files}
        bytes = Files.json(manifest)
        same_request!
        Files.once(File.join(target,DatasetDelivery::MANIFEST),bytes)
        delivery = DatasetDelivery.open(target,expected_manifest_sha256: Files.hash(bytes))
        completion = {"schema"=>RESULT_SCHEMA,"requestSha256"=>@request_sha256,
          "datasetId"=>@request["datasetId"],"sourceKey"=>@request["sourceKey"],
          "sourceId"=>receipt["sourceId"],"nativeReceiptSha256"=>Files.hash(raw),
          "directory"=>target,"manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256}
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"received.json"),Files.json(completion))
        self.class.received(directory: @directory)
      end
    end

    private
    def initialize_retained(root, request, bytes)
      runtime = request["runtime"]
      Files.need(request["room"].is_a?(String) && File.expand_path(request["room"]) == request["room"] &&
        runtime.is_a?(Hash) && runtime["files"].is_a?(Array) &&
        %w[directory python node].all? { |key| runtime[key].is_a?(String) &&
          File.expand_path(runtime[key]) == runtime[key] }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RUNTIME_SELECTION_INVALID")
      @directory,@request,@request_bytes = root,request,bytes.dup.freeze
      @room,@runtime,@request_sha256 = request["room"],runtime,Files.hash(bytes).freeze
      DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@request)
      Files.directory(File.join(root,"attempts"),create: true)
      Files.directory(File.join(root,"received"),create: true)
    end

    def copy_original(target, name, expected)
      parent = DatasetDelivery.parent_directory(target,name,create: true)
      destination = File.join(parent,File.basename(name))
      if File.exist?(destination) || File.symlink?(destination)
        DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(destination,expected) { |_stream| }
        return
      end
      # The same descriptor is fully verified before any bytes enter the packet.
      # Atomic create-only publication lets an interrupted transfer resume.
      DatasetDelivery.parent_directory(@room,name)
      temp = Tempfile.new([".native-dataset-", ".pending"],parent)
      begin
        temp.binmode
        DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(File.join(@room,name),expected) do |source|
          while (chunk = source.read(1_048_576))
            written = 0
            while written < chunk.bytesize
              count = temp.write(chunk.byteslice(written,chunk.bytesize-written))
              Files.need(count && count > 0, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COPY_FAILED")
              written += count
            end
          end
        end
        temp.flush
        temp.fsync
        temp.close
        begin
          File.link(temp.path,destination)
          Files.sync(parent)
        rescue Errno::EEXIST
          DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(destination,expected) { |_stream| }
        end
      ensure
        temp.close!
      end
    end
  end
end

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Commission the complete original finalized dataset in a customer Rails
# data layer, export every preview/receipt row, and reopen its recipient offline.
require "optparse"
require_relative "../native_dataset_receiving"
require_relative "rails_dataset/models"
require_relative "rails_dataset/create_dataset_import_tables"

module Starforge
  module NativeDatasetLifecycle
    SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-lifecycle.v1"
    APP_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-application.v1"
    APP_MANIFEST = "application-delivery.json"
    APP_FILES = %w[application.sqlite3 mapping.json selection.json receipt.json preview.json preview.csv edition.json].freeze
    DETACH_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-producer-detach.v1"
    PRODUCER_PATHS = %w[lifecycle-input.json mapping.json commit-plan.json application-commit.json outputs recipient receiving application.sqlite3].freeze
    TENANT = "native-customer"
    TABLE = "starforge_native_dataset_records"
    class SourceRow < DatasetExample::Record
      self.table_name = TABLE
    end
    module_function

    def disconnect
      ActiveRecord::Base.connection_pool.disconnect! if ActiveRecord::Base.connected?
    end

    def connect(path)
      disconnect
      ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3",database: path,timeout: 5000)
      connection = ActiveRecord::Base.connection
      connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
      connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE")
      SourceRow.reset_column_information
      connection
    end

    def mapping_for(delivery, selected_keys)
      keys = selected_keys.empty? && delivery.semantics&.dig("primaryKey","complete") == true ?
        delivery.semantics.fetch("primaryKey").fetch("projected") : selected_keys
      Files.need(keys.is_a?(Array) && !keys.empty? && keys.uniq == keys &&
        keys.all? { |key| delivery.fields.include?(key) }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ORIGINAL_KEYS_REQUIRED")
      columns = delivery.native_receipt.fetch("columns")
      specs = columns.each_with_index.to_h do |column,index|
        name = format("value_%03d",index)
        native_type = column.fetch("type")
        type = {"string"=>"string","integer"=>"integer","number"=>"string","boolean"=>"boolean"}.fetch(native_type)
        [name,{"field"=>column.fetch("name"),"type"=>type,"null"=>"assign","missing"=>"error",
          "stringify"=>native_type == "number"}]
      end
      {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.rails-dataset-mapping.v1","columns"=>specs,
        "key_columns"=>keys.map { |key| specs.find { |_name,item| item["field"] == key }.first },
        "removal"=>{"strategy"=>"retain"}}
    end

    def initialize_database(path, delivery, mapping)
      connection = connect(path)
      names = %w[starforge_dataset_streams starforge_dataset_editions starforge_dataset_rows
        starforge_dataset_entries starforge_dataset_catalog_records]
      present = names.map { |name| connection.table_exists?(name) }
      Files.need(present.all? || present.none?, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_SCHEMA_INCOMPLETE")
      unless present.all?
        connection.transaction do
          ActiveRecord::Migration.suppress_messages { CreateDatasetImportTables.new.migrate(:up) }
          connection.create_table(TABLE) do |table|
            table.string :tenant_key,null: false,limit: 128
            delivery.native_receipt.fetch("columns").each_with_index do |column,index|
              name = format("value_%03d",index)
              options = {null: column.fetch("nullable")}
              case column.fetch("type")
              when "integer" then table.bigint(name,**options)
              when "boolean" then table.boolean(name,**options)
              else table.text(name,**options)
              end
            end
            table.integer :lock_version,null: false,default: 0
            table.timestamps
          end
          connection.add_index(TABLE,["tenant_key"]+mapping.fetch("key_columns"),
            unique: true,name: "sf_native_source_key")
        end
      end
      Files.need(connection.table_exists?(TABLE), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_SCHEMA_INCOMPLETE")

    def importer(delivery, source_key, mapping)

    def file_descriptor(path)
      File.open(path,File::RDONLY | File::NOFOLLOW | File::NONBLOCK) do |file|
        before = file.stat
        Files.need(before.file? && before.uid == Process.uid && (before.mode & 0077).zero?,
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRIVATE_OUTPUT_REQUIRED")
        digest,count = Digest::SHA256.new,0
        while (chunk = file.read(1_048_576))
          digest.update(chunk)
          count += chunk.bytesize
        end
        after = file.stat
        Files.need(count == before.size && [before.dev,before.ino,before.size,before.mtime,before.ctime] ==
          [after.dev,after.ino,after.size,after.mtime,after.ctime], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OUTPUT_CHANGED")
        {"path"=>path,"bytes"=>count,"sha256"=>digest.hexdigest}
      end
    end

    def write_output(path,&block)
      DatasetExample::Artifacts.write_once(path,&block)
    end


    def descriptor_at(root, relative)
      file_descriptor(File.join(root,relative)).merge("path"=>relative)
    end

    # Verify the complete selected file while writing the unpublished output.
    # Its size may exceed the native dataset input ceiling (database/history).
    def copy_output(source_path, target_path, expected)
      write_output(target_path) do |io|
        File.open(source_path,File::RDONLY | File::NOFOLLOW | File::NONBLOCK) do |source|
          before = source.stat
          Files.need(before.file? && before.uid == Process.uid && (before.mode & 0077).zero? &&
            before.size == expected.fetch("bytes"), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRIVATE_OUTPUT_REQUIRED")
          count,digest = 0,Digest::SHA256.new
          while (chunk = source.read(1_048_576))
            count += chunk.bytesize
            Files.need(count <= expected.fetch("bytes"), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OUTPUT_CHANGED")
            digest.update(chunk)
            written = 0
            while written < chunk.bytesize
              amount = io.write(chunk.byteslice(written,chunk.bytesize-written))
              Files.need(amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount > 0, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OUTPUT_WRITE")
              written += amount
            end
          end
          after = source.stat
          Files.need(count == expected.fetch("bytes") && digest.hexdigest == expected.fetch("sha256") &&
            [before.dev,before.ino,before.size,before.mtime,before.ctime] ==
            [after.dev,after.ino,after.size,after.mtime,after.ctime], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OUTPUT_CHANGED")
        end
      end
    end

    def receiving_database(recipient, expected)
      artifact = File.join(recipient,"application.sqlite3")
      working = File.join(recipient,"readback.sqlite3")
      unless File.exist?(working) || File.symlink?(working)
        copy_output(artifact,working,expected)
      end
      File.open(working,File::RDONLY | File::NOFOLLOW | File::NONBLOCK) do |file|
        stat = file.stat
        Files.need(stat.file? && stat.uid == Process.uid && (stat.mode & 0077).zero? &&
          stat.nlink == 1 && File.realpath(working) == working,
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRIVATE_DATABASE_REQUIRED")
      end
      connect(working)
    end

    def verify_complete_receipt(import, operation_key, expected)
      digest,count = Digest::SHA256.new,0
      sink = Object.new
      sink.define_singleton_method(:write) do |bytes|
        digest.update(bytes.b)
        count += bytes.bytesize
        bytes.bytesize
      end
      import.write_receipt(sink,operation_key: operation_key)
      Files.need(count == expected.fetch("bytes") && digest.hexdigest == expected.fetch("sha256"),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMPLETE_APPLICATION_ROWS_CHANGED")
    end

    def verify_current_targets(import, delivery)
      preview = import.preview
      begin
        summary = preview.summary
        counts = summary.fetch("counts")
        Files.need(summary.fetch("row_count") == delivery.row_count &&
          counts.fetch("unchanged") == delivery.row_count &&
          %w[inserted updated removed adopted restored source_changed].all? { |name| counts.fetch(name) == 0 } &&
          SourceRow.where(tenant_key: TENANT).count == delivery.row_count,
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_CURRENT_APPLICATION_ROWS_CHANGED")
        # Reading every sealed entry also verifies the complete preview stream.
        seen = 0
        preview.each_entry do |entry|
          Files.need(entry.fetch("action") == "unchanged", "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_CURRENT_APPLICATION_ROWS_CHANGED")
          seen += 1
        end
        Files.need(seen == delivery.row_count, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_CURRENT_APPLICATION_ROWS_CHANGED")
        summary
      ensure
        preview.close
      end
    end

    def row_summary(delivery)
      count,digest,types = 0,Digest::SHA256.new,delivery.fields.to_h { |name| [name,{}] }
      delivery.each_record do |record|
        digest.update(record.fetch("raw_json").b)
        digest.update("\n")
        record.fetch("values").each do |name,value|
          kind = value.nil? ? "null" : value == true || value == false ? "boolean" :
            value.is_a?(BigDecimal) ? "decimal" : value.is_a?(Integer) ? "integer" : "string"
          types.fetch(name)[kind] = types.fetch(name).fetch(kind,0)+1
        end
        count += 1
      end
      Files.need(count == delivery.row_count && digest.hexdigest == delivery.descriptor("dataset.jsonl")["sha256"],
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ROWS_CHANGED")
      {"rows"=>count,"fields"=>delivery.fields,"jsonlSha256"=>digest.hexdigest,"types"=>types}
    end

      {"root"=>root,"bytes"=>bytes,"manifest"=>manifest,"manifestSha256"=>expected_manifest_sha256,

    def receive_application(root, expected_manifest_sha256:)

    def present?(path)

    end

    # A process interruption may leave our own producer paths parked here.
    # Restore the exact selected paths before any run/reopen selection is made.
    def restore_producer(root)
      staging = File.join(root,"producer-retained")
      return unless present?(staging)
      Files.directory(staging)
      marker = File.join(staging,"detach.json")
      unless File.exist?(marker)
        Files.need(Dir.children(staging).empty?, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_SELECTION")
        Dir.rmdir(staging)
        Files.sync(root)
        return
      end
      state = Files.parse(Files.read(marker,1_048_576))
      Files.need(state["schema"] == DETACH_SCHEMA && state["paths"] == PRODUCER_PATHS &&
        HASH.match?(state["inputSha256"].to_s), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_SELECTION")
      original_input = File.join(root,"lifecycle-input.json")
      input_path = present?(original_input) ? original_input : File.join(staging,"lifecycle-input.json")
      Files.need(Files.hash(Files.read(input_path,1_048_576)) == state.fetch("inputSha256"),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_SELECTION")
      PRODUCER_PATHS.each do |name|
        parked,original = File.join(staging,name),File.join(root,name)
        if present?(parked)
          Files.need(!present?(original), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_CONFLICT")
          File.rename(parked,original)
          Files.sync(staging)
          Files.sync(root)
        else
          Files.need(present?(original), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_MISSING")
        end
      end
      Files.need(Dir.children(staging) == ["detach.json"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_SELECTION")
      File.unlink(marker)
      Files.sync(staging)
      Dir.rmdir(staging)
      Files.sync(root)
    end

    def detached_receive(root, recipient, expected_manifest_sha256:)
      restore_producer(root)
      Files.need(PRODUCER_PATHS.all? { |name| present?(File.join(root,name)) },

      staging = Files.directory(File.join(root,"producer-retained"),create: true)
      state = {"schema"=>DETACH_SCHEMA,"inputSha256"=>Files.hash(Files.read(File.join(root,"lifecycle-input.json"),1_048_576)),
        "paths"=>PRODUCER_PATHS}
      Files.once(File.join(staging,"detach.json"),Files.json(state))
      begin
        PRODUCER_PATHS.each do |name|
          Files.need(!present?(File.join(staging,name)), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_CONFLICT")
          File.rename(File.join(root,name),File.join(staging,name))
          Files.sync(root)
          Files.sync(staging)
        end
        Files.need(PRODUCER_PATHS.none? { |name| present?(File.join(root,name)) },
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_STILL_AVAILABLE")
        received = receive_application(recipient,expected_manifest_sha256: expected_manifest_sha256)
        received.merge("producerPathsUnavailable"=>true,"detachedProducerPaths"=>PRODUCER_PATHS)
      ensure

      end
    end

        # independent copy. The original customer room is never renamed.
        first = receive_application(recipient,expected_manifest_sha256: expected)
        copied_root = File.join(root,"received-application")
        copy_application(recipient,expected_manifest_sha256: expected,out: copied_root)
        detached = detached_receive(root,copied_root,expected_manifest_sha256: expected)
        result = {"schema"=>SCHEMA,"status"=>"COMMITTED_AND_REOPENED",
          "inputSha256"=>Files.hash(input_bytes),"sourceId"=>delivery.source_sha256,
          "nativeReceiptSha256"=>delivery.descriptor("native-receiving.json")["sha256"],
          "nativeSourceBindingSha256"=>delivery.manifest["sourceBindingSha256"],
          "deliveryManifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,"membership"=>delivery.membership,
          "rows"=>package.fetch("manifest").fetch("rows"),"preview"=>plan.fetch("preview"),"receipt"=>receipt,
          "runtime"=>observed,"applicationDatabase"=>"application.sqlite3",
          "applicationManifestSha256"=>expected,"applicationManifest"=>APP_MANIFEST,
          "outputs"=>package.fetch("manifest").fetch("outputs"),"recipient"=>"recipient",
          "receivedApplication"=>"received-application",
          "firstReceiving"=>first.reject { |key,_value| key == "directory" },
          "detachedReceiving"=>detached.reject { |key,_value| key == "directory" }}
        Files.once(File.join(root,"native-rails-result.json"),Files.json(result))
        reopen_locked(root)
      end
    ensure
      disconnect
    end

    def main(argv)
      command = argv.shift
      options = {"keys"=>[]}
      parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
        o.banner = "ruby examples/native_dataset_lifecycle.rb run --out PRIVATE_DIR --room ORIGINAL_ROOM --native-manifest-sha256 SHA --source-key KEY --dataset-id ID --checkout SOURCE --python ABS --node ABS [--key ORIGINAL_FIELD]\nruby examples/native_dataset_lifecycle.rb reopen --out PRIVATE_DIR\nruby examples/native_dataset_lifecycle.rb receive --delivery APPLICATION_FOLDER --manifest-sha256 SHA\nruby examples/native_dataset_lifecycle.rb copy --delivery APPLICATION_FOLDER --manifest-sha256 SHA --out NEW_FOLDER"
        %w[out room source-key dataset-id checkout python node delivery].each do |name|
          o.on("--"+name+" VALUE") { |value| options[name.tr("-","_")] = value }
        end
        o.on("--native-manifest-sha256 SHA") { |value| options["native_manifest"] = value }
        o.on("--manifest-sha256 SHA") { |value| options["manifest"] = value }
        o.on("--key FIELD") { |value| options["keys"] << value }
        o.on("--help") { puts o; return 0 }
      end
      parser.parse!(argv)
      Files.need(argv.empty? && %w[run reopen receive copy].include?(command),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_LIFECYCLE_OPTIONS")
      old_umask = File.umask(0077)
      begin
        if command == "reopen"
          Files.need(options["out"] && (options.keys-%w[out keys]).empty? && options["keys"].empty?,
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OFFLINE_OPTIONS")
          $stdout.write(Files.json(reopen(options["out"])))
          return 0
        end
        if %w[receive copy].include?(command)
          allowed = command == "copy" ? %w[delivery manifest keys out] : %w[delivery manifest keys]
          Files.need(options["delivery"] && HASH.match?(options["manifest"].to_s) &&
            (options.keys-allowed).empty? && options["keys"].empty? &&
            (command != "copy" || options["out"]), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OFFLINE_OPTIONS")
          value = if command == "receive"
            receive_application(options.fetch("delivery"),expected_manifest_sha256: options.fetch("manifest"))
          else
            copy_application(options.fetch("delivery"),expected_manifest_sha256: options.fetch("manifest"),
              out: options.fetch("out"))
          end
          $stdout.write(Files.json(value))
          return 0
        end
        Files.need(%w[out room source_key dataset_id native_manifest checkout python node].all? { |key| options[key] } &&
          (options.keys-%w[out room source_key dataset_id native_manifest checkout python node keys]).empty? &&
          HASH.match?(options["native_manifest"].to_s), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_LIFECYCLE_SELECTION")
        %w[out room checkout python node].each { |key| options[key] = File.expand_path(options.fetch(key)) }
        interrupted = false
        cancellation = Object.new
        cancellation.define_singleton_method(:cancelled?) { interrupted }
        old_int = Signal.trap("INT") { interrupted = true }
        old_term = Signal.trap("TERM") { interrupted = true }
        begin
          $stdout.write(Files.json(run(options,cancellation)))
          0
        ensure
          Signal.trap("INT",old_int)
          Signal.trap("TERM",old_term)
        end
      ensure
        File.umask(old_umask)
      end
    rescue Starforge::Error, RailsDataset::ImportError, OptionParser::ParseError => error
      $stderr.write(JSON.generate({"error"=>error.respond_to?(:code) ? error.code : "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_LIFECYCLE_OPTIONS",
        "details"=>error.respond_to?(:details) ? error.details : {}})+"\n")
      2
    end
  end
end
exit Starforge::NativeDatasetLifecycle.main(ARGV.dup) if File.expand_path($PROGRAM_NAME) == File.expand_path(__FILE__)

require "optparse"
require_relative "models"

module Starforge
  module DatasetExample
    module Commission
      module_function
      def run(arguments)
        options = {}
        parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
          o.banner = "bin/rails runner /absolute/package/examples/rails_dataset/commission.rb COMMAND -- [options]"
          o.separator "Commands: init, preview, commit, receipt, status"
          o.on("--tenant KEY", "Authenticated application's tenant key") { |v| options[:tenant] = v }
          o.on("--stream NAME", "Stable dataset stream within that tenant") { |v| options[:stream] = v }
          o.on("--delivery DIRECTORY", "Original complete received dataset") { |v| options[:delivery] = v }
          o.on("--manifest-sha256 SHA", "Selected dataset-customer.json SHA-256") { |v| options[:manifest] = v }
          o.on("--mapping PATH", "Application's explicit JSON field mapping") { |v| options[:mapping] = v }
          o.on("--out DIRECTORY", "Existing private complete-output directory") { |v| options[:out] = v }
          o.on("--operation KEY", "Stable application edition operation key") { |v| options[:operation] = v }
          o.on("--preview-sha256 SHA", "Exact full preview selected for commit") { |v| options[:preview] = v }
          o.on("-h", "--help") { puts o; return 0 }
        end
        command = arguments.shift
        if command.nil? || %w[-h --help].include?(command)
          puts parser
          return 0
        end
        # Rails runner retains all following arguments; accept its optional
        # delimiter without allowing unknown flags to disappear silently.
        arguments.shift if arguments.first == "--"
        parser.parse!(arguments)
        RailsDataset.need(arguments.empty? && %w[init preview commit receipt status].include?(command),
          "DATASET_COMMISSION_COMMAND")
        required = [:tenant, :stream]
        required += [:delivery, :manifest, :mapping] if %w[preview commit receipt].include?(command)
        required += [:out] if %w[preview receipt].include?(command)
        required += [:operation, :preview] if command == "commit"
        required += [:operation] if command == "receipt"
        required.each do |key|
          RailsDataset.need(options[key].is_a?(String) && !options[key].strip.empty?,
            "DATASET_COMMISSION_OPTION", option: key)
        end
        stream_scope = DatasetStream.where(tenant_key: options[:tenant], name: options[:stream])
        if command == "init"
          # The unique tenant/name index resolves concurrent job creation.
          stream = stream_scope.create_or_find_by!({})
          puts RailsDataset.json({"stream_id"=>stream.id.to_s, "tenant"=>stream.tenant_key,
            "name"=>stream.name, "revision"=>stream.revision})
          return 0
        end
        stream = stream_scope.take!
        if command == "status"
          editions = DatasetEdition.where(dataset_stream_id: stream.id)
          puts RailsDataset.json({"stream_id"=>stream.id.to_s, "tenant"=>stream.tenant_key, "name"=>stream.name,
            "revision"=>stream.revision, "latest_edition_id"=>stream.latest_edition_id&.to_s,
            "target_model"=>stream.target_model, "scope_sha256"=>stream.scope_sha256,
            "key_mapping_sha256"=>stream.key_mapping_sha256, "membership_sha256"=>stream.membership_sha256,
            "editions"=>editions.count,
            "active_keys"=>DatasetRow.where(dataset_stream_id: stream.id, status: "active").count,
            "removed_keys"=>DatasetRow.where(dataset_stream_id: stream.id, status: "removed").count})
          return 0
        end
        importer = DatasetExample.importer(stream: stream, tenant_key: options[:tenant],
          delivery_directory: options[:delivery], manifest_sha256: options[:manifest], mapping_path: options[:mapping])
        case command
        when "preview"
          directory = Files.directory(options[:out])
          preview = importer.preview
          begin
            stem = "preview-#{preview.sha256}"
            files = [
              Artifacts.write_once(File.join(directory, "#{stem}.json")) { |io| preview.write_json(io) },
              Artifacts.write_once(File.join(directory, "#{stem}.csv")) { |io| preview.write_csv(io) }
            ]
            puts RailsDataset.json(preview.summary.merge("outputs"=>files))
          ensure
            preview.close
          end
        when "commit"
          result = importer.import!(operation_key: options[:operation], expected_preview_sha256: options[:preview])
          if options[:out]
            directory = Files.directory(options[:out])
            name = "edition-#{result.fetch("revision")}-#{result.fetch("operation_sha256")}.json"
            output = Artifacts.write_once(File.join(directory,name)) do |io|
              importer.write_receipt(io, operation_key: options[:operation])
            end
            result = result.merge("complete_receipt"=>output)
          end
          puts RailsDataset.json(result)
        when "receipt"
          directory = Files.directory(options[:out])
          result = importer.receipt(operation_key: options[:operation])
          name = "edition-#{result.fetch("revision")}-#{result.fetch("operation_sha256")}.json"
          output = Artifacts.write_once(File.join(directory,name)) do |io|
            importer.write_receipt(io, operation_key: options[:operation])
          end
          puts RailsDataset.json(result.merge("complete_receipt"=>output))
        end
        0
      rescue Starforge::Error, RailsDataset::ImportError, OptionParser::ParseError => error
        warn JSON.generate({"error"=>error.respond_to?(:code) ? error.code : error.class.name,
          "details"=>error.respond_to?(:details) ? error.details : {"message"=>error.message}})
        2
      end
    end
  end
end

exit Starforge::DatasetExample::Commission.run(ARGV.dup) if File.expand_path($PROGRAM_NAME) == File.expand_path(__FILE__)
